messages:
Aurora Vega: hey team :wave: i'm aurora, joined today as a backend engineer (she/they). relocating from a tiny town in oregon. hobbies: making bad pottery, collecting vintage cheese labels, and hosting a tiny podcast about late-night diner food. excited to meet y'all and learn the codebase!
Ben Holt: welcome aurora!! :tada: podcast + cheese labels = iconic. we have a kitchen cheese shelf but it's fiercely policed :cheese:. also we do a monthly "office playlist" if you want to add an episode theme song.
Maya Ortiz: hi aurora, welcome!! are you team brie or team cheddar? and honestly pottery sounds cool, would love to see photos.
Aurora Vega: @Maya team brie for life, but i'll defend a good sharp cheddar. photos incoming soon.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Aurora! Please complete badge pickup and equipment request: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>. New hire intro lunch is Friday noon. Reply "help" for assistance.
Ben Holt: tiny logistics: snack shelf rules say label perishable items and sign the communal log if you leave opened cheese. SnackBot will remind you after 5 days.
SnackBot: Reminder scheduled: label perishable food in the fridge. Reply "snooze" to delay.
Aurora Vega: thanks everyone! quick Q: is there a good place to record 20-min podcast bits on-site or nearby?
Maya Ortiz: conference room C has decent acoustics after 6pm, or we sometimes use quiet booth on 3rd floor. ping me and i'll help set it up.
Ben Holt: welcome aboard aurora, and bring your pottery to the holiday swap :grin:
Aurora Vega: will do! see you all around :heart:
